answer.question: Can a Lone Tree townhome owner request a turf estimate?
answer.answer: Yes. First confirm who owns or controls the proposed outdoor area and obtain the applicable association requirements. A patio or strip beside an attached home may be shared. Bring the plan and any building conditions to the consultation so the surface can be considered for that space.

blocks.h2: Start with a useful putting line.
paras: For a detached yard in the Fairways or Heritage Hills, compare where a green would sit beside the patio and planting. Decide on putt lengths, walking space and any chipping before selecting its size. A lawn or pet area can remain separate.

blocks.h2: Confirm the boundary before choosing the footprint.
paras: For a condo or townhome, identify who can authorize the work and any restrictions on delivery or access. On a terrace, have the responsible building professional confirm loading, waterproofing and drainage before ordering turf.

Lone Tree properties have different water providers and property requirements. Use the exact address when checking City requirements or incentives, and bring applicable association conditions to the estimate.

servicesNote: Discuss lawn, pet and putting options for the outdoor area your property allows you to change.
